urls.rationale: §6B-2-1 West Virginia Ethics Commission created — enforcing agency for the lobbying regime.
§6B-2-2 General powers and duties of the Ethics Commission.
§6B-2-2a Probable Cause Review Board — enforcement scaffolding.
§6B-2-3 Advisory opinions; enforcement; applicability; legislative review; rule making.
§6B-2-4 Processing complaints; dismissals; hearings; disposition; judicial review.
§6B-2-10 Violations and penalties — Ethics Commission penalty backbone.

notes: Excluded §6B-2-5/5a/5b (ethical standards / ALJ code of conduct / ethics training — officials' conduct rules, not lobbying-cross-referenced), §6B-2-6/7/8 (officials' financial disclosure statements — separate disclosure regime, not the lobbying one), §6B-2-11 (empty/reserved). Same filter as WV 2015 — 2010 is missing 2015's §6B-2-5C but otherwise identical filtering.
